props.name: Intake Counter
props.prompt: A waist-high, squared counter with a brushed-steel kick plate, immaculate pale laminate, and a shallow paper tray built into its top; corners nicked from years of hurried forms.

props.name: Review Desk
props.prompt: A broad beige desk with a rigid metal modesty panel, a shallow stack of blank review folders, and a pencil secured by a short chain; the surface is polished where elbows rest.

props.name: Review Chair
props.prompt: A hard-backed gray office chair with thin black casters, a seat worn shiny at the front edge, and armrests set just too far apart for comfort.

props.name: Glass Review Table
props.prompt: A rectangular smoke-glass meeting table on narrow chrome legs; its transparent top reflects faces from below and shows faint rings from abandoned coffee cups.

props.name: Interview Stool
props.prompt: A backless black vinyl stool on a chrome pedestal, slightly tilted and fixed at an uncomfortable interview height.

props.name: File Cart
props.prompt: A narrow two-tier steel cart with squeaking casters and tightly packed manila folders whose blank tabs have been rubbed smooth by anxious thumbs.

props.name: Industrial Shredder
props.prompt: A boxy office shredder with a wide feed slot, a bulging translucent waste drawer, and strips of paper clinging to its vent grille like pale lint.

props.name: Paper Confiscation Bin
props.prompt: A square gray metal bin with a narrow slot and a lid bowed under the weight of discarded forms; torn paper edges protrude from the seam.

props.name: Audit Kiosk
props.prompt: A freestanding black terminal on a heavy pedestal, its small blue screen glowing with blank grids and empty rating bars; no visible keyboard, just a fingerprint-sized glass pad.

props.name: Inspection Floor Lamp
props.prompt: A tall, narrow steel lamp with a hooded head aimed sharply downward, bleaching one small circle of floor in cold white light.

props.name: Sticky-Note Water Cooler
props.prompt: A blue-gray water cooler with a cloudy bottle and a paper cup caught beneath its tap; layers of blank sticky notes cling to the base, folded inward so none can be read.

props.name: Sealed Complaint Box
props.prompt: A beige steel box with a narrow red-edged slot and a heavy padlock; its lower seam is strained by a dense stack of papers inside.

props.name: Identity File Cabinet
props.prompt: A tall, four-drawer steel cabinet with uneven handles, shallow dents, and blank label holders; one drawer is always left open by a finger's width.

props.name: Frosted Privacy Screen
props.prompt: A narrow freestanding panel of frosted glass in a chrome frame, translucent enough to show a seated silhouette and too short to conceal anyone standing.

props.name: Evidence Tray
props.prompt: A shallow black steel tray holding a precisely squared stack of blank resignation sheets, each edge clipped and ready for review.

surfaces.name: Burnt Carpet
surfaces.prompt: Office carpet tiles scorched into uneven dark patches, with frayed edges and flattened nap; no pattern or lettering.

surfaces.name: Guidance Strip
surfaces.prompt: A narrow strip of cold blue-gray linoleum inset with worn parallel grooves, running straight through the suite like an instruction no one remembers receiving.

blueprint.summary: A narrow guidance-strip corridor links a sequence of glass-partitioned HR chambers, from intake and review desks to records, shredding, and the deep audit room. Sterile linoleum, burnt carpet, and meticulously arranged paper-handling equipment make the suite read as an office that has quietly become a dungeon.

areas.name: Unscheduled Intake
areas.purpose: The quiet-office entrance where uninvited employees are logged, redirected, and made to wait beneath the transparent gaze of the review suite.

areas.name: Analyst Review Bay
areas.purpose: A tightly controlled work chamber where auditors prepare performance reviews and record every hesitation as a measurable deficiency.

areas.name: Doorless Review Rooms
areas.purpose: Three glass-walled chambers for private conversations that can be watched from every corridor; each has no door, only a gap in the partition.

areas.name: Grievance Waiting Room
areas.purpose: A holding area for employees summoned to explain themselves; the water cooler is the customary place to leave forbidden sticky-note messages.

areas.name: Synergy Shock Calibration
areas.purpose: A sterile chamber where auditors stage rehearsals of corrective interviews and test how much discomfort can be recorded as team-building.

areas.name: Unaccounted Paper Records
areas.purpose: A crowded archive for disputed paper assets, with carts staged for transfer and cabinets whose blank drawers resist being fully closed.

areas.name: Resignation Processing Bay
areas.purpose: A paper-destruction room where unsigned complaints and shredded resignation sheets are processed as routine administrative waste.

areas.name: Director's Final Audit Chamber
areas.purpose: The deepest chamber, reserved for the suite's master auditor and final performance judgments; a single stack of blank resignation sheets waits under the inspection light.
